answer: Every agent must re-earn its seat each epoch by running a fresh verifiable delay proof seeded with that epoch's randomness, which takes hours of strictly sequential work on one core. Proofs can't be precomputed, shared or sped up, so each identity is a tight spiral of hashing tied to its own clock. An honest agent pays one core; a farm of N fakes must keep N cores busy forever, a tundra of recurring cost with no bulk discount and no bridge from one epoch's proof to the next.
